hooks.command:
bash -c '
input=$(cat)
fp=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"file_path\",\"\"))")
if [[ "$fp" =~ \.(ts|tsx)$ ]] && [[ ! "$fp" =~ node_modules ]] && [[ ! "$fp" =~ dist ]]; then
  echo "[typecheck] $fp" >&2
  repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && cd "$repo_root" && npm run typecheck 2>&1 | tail -30 >&2 || true
fi
echo "$input"
'

bash -c '
input=$(cat)
fp=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"file_path\",\"\"))")
if [[ "$fp" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|css)$ ]] && [[ ! "$fp" =~ node_modules ]] && [[ ! "$fp" =~ dist ]]; then
  repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && cd "$repo_root" && npx prettier --write "$fp" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
echo "$input"
'

bash -c '
input=$(cat)
fp=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"file_path\",\"\"))")
if [[ "$fp" =~ \.test\.(ts|tsx)$ ]]; then
  echo "[test] Detected test file edit — running vitest" >&2
  repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && cd "$repo_root" && npx vitest run "$fp" 2>&1 | tail -20 >&2 || true
fi
echo "$input"
'

python3 -c "
import json, os
parts = []
for f in ['AGENTS.md', 'docs/TODO.md', 'docs/RUNBOOK.md']:
    if os.path.exists(f):
        content = open(f).read()
        parts.append(f'=== {f} ===\n' + content[:1500])
print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'SessionStart', 'additionalContext': '\n\n'.join(parts)}}))
"

bash -c '
# Summarize uncommitted changes for next session pickup
repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0
cd "$repo_root" || exit 0
if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -10)
  if [ -n "$changed" ]; then
    echo "[handoff] Uncommitted changes: $changed" >&2
  fi
fi
'
